text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days ago…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Spring is here—the Classics season.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I was hoping that it'd be a warm spring, but there's still a chill in the air…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All I seem to have brought you is pain and sadness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even when burdened by the memory of her bad health around the time of the Sumire Stakes, Super Creek desperately continues working her hardest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can keep going. Just a little bit more…
choice_data_list: Consider the state of your body.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Mnh… You're right… I'll end up causing you more trouble if I push any harder.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm so ashamed for causing you to make such a fuss over me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, could I at least help you out in some other way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to do some shopping, partly as a way to lighten her mood.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew! I haven't had this much fun shopping in ages! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let me know if there's anywhere else you'd like to stop by, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, do you want to go get a parfait? My treat. It's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as I think it's been a while since I've seen her enjoy herself…

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text: The wait is over, Umamusume fans! It's time for this month's Race Flash!

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text: Let's take a look at the Satsuki Sho's main contenders as they train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several Umamusume are shown one after another on the big TV screen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They can all be seen racing enthusiastically.

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text: But it's a shame that Super Creek isn't featured here.

text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator
text_block_list.text: It really is. Many fans had great expectations of her, but at the moment, it seems unlikely that she'll race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
choice_data_list: Don't let it get to you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I won't. There's nothing I can do about it. I brought this on myself…

text_block_list.name: TV Host
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I hear that Super Creek's trainer is a newcomer with no record to speak of.

text_block_list.name: Racing Commentator
text_block_list.text: Yes, perhaps it's that lack of experience that's hindering Super Creek's amazing talent and potential.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um… Do you mind if we go back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I want to train some more. If it weren't for me, then…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But it is my fault that they're saying those horrible things about you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And… all I wanted was to make you smile…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I need to work harder to make you happy…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I… U-urgh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I return to my office and think about Super Creek's condition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The color suddenly drained from her face earlier when she resolved to work harder for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't be sure, but…
choice_data_list: Maybe the reason for her bad health is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I might have made an important realization. I'll keep an eye on Super Creek for a little longer.
